kpis.description_en: Maintenance Products segment revenue (95% of total). WD-40 Multi-Use + Specialist. Historical core. Targets 4-bn distribution 2025+.

kpis.description_en: Asia Pacific segment revenue (China + India + ASEAN). Strongest long-term growth vs mature markets. China macro pressure 2023-2024.
